solutions.title: Autocharge
solutions.desc: Plug in, charging starts. No action required. Proven high satisfaction.

solutions.title: CK Charge Mobile App
solutions.desc: B2C mobile application to find station, start/stop charging, onboard autocharge, see transactions etc. Proven high satisfaction.

solutions.title: Tap & Pay - Logos
solutions.desc: Customer can unregistered pay for charging session with their card or x-wallet. This solution does not have integration with Extra nor provides automatic reconciliation.

solutions.title: Tap & Pay - Adyen (S1U2)
solutions.desc: Customer can unregistered pay for charging session with their card or x-wallet. This solution has integration with Extra and provides automatic reconciliation.

solutions.title: GMAP Convergence
solutions.desc: One integrated experience that delivers the market's easiest and most rewarding EV-charging experience while unifying customer experience across all CK functions.

solutions.title: Car dealership giftcard acquisition pilot
solutions.desc: Micro-testing a giftcard initiative in partnership with car dealerships. Hypothesis: introducing Circle K to EV drivers at point of new car pickup drives first charging sessions and app downloads.

solutions.title: Migrate M4 Payment terminal to EV One
solutions.desc: Evaluation of migrating M4 market payment terminals to the EV One platform. Scope, dependencies, and feasibility under active assessment.

solutions.title: Inbound Roaming
solutions.desc: Active eMSP connections enabling customers from partner networks to charge at Circle K stations. Connected eMSPs: Elton (NO, SE, DK), Mer (SE), Radius (IE), Ayvens (NO), NFL (NO).

solutions.title: Show 1M chargepoints and prices in GMAP
solutions.desc: Surfacing 1M+ chargepoints with live pricing across the roaming network directly inside the Circle K app.

solutions.title: Show 1M chargepoints and prices in Webmap
solutions.desc: Surfacing 1M+ chargepoints with live pricing across the roaming network on the Circle K web map.

risks.description: Pricing opacity and authentication inconsistency for non-native users creates distrust and discourages repeat use.
risks.mitigation: OCPI-based roaming improvements in evaluation. Transparent pricing pre-session is unexplored.

risks.description: Certificate-based authentication requires vehicle OEM adoption and charger firmware updates. External dependency not within Circle K's control.
risks.mitigation: Evaluation stage. Monitor OEM adoption curves. ISO 15118-2 (MAC-based) already live as interim.

risks.description: Requires OCPP session data combined with vehicle API access. Both are externally dependent and market is fragmented across OEMs.
risks.mitigation: Discovery only. Not a near-term priority. Monitor standardisation progress.

risks.description: Re-prioritisation of resources to 1CP assessed as high likelihood of impact on the B2C GVSL Roadmap. Scope and timeline of affected initiatives not yet fully defined.
risks.mitigation: Escalate to eMM. Clarify which B2C GVSL items are at risk and reprioritise accordingly.

risks.description: Converging away from the Circle K Charge App risks increased customer friction and potential customer loss for users not successfully migrated to GMAP. Commercial GTM model not yet confirmed.
risks.mitigation: Define migration plan and rollback strategy. Validate GTM approach before full rollout. Phased market launch (Latvia/Lithuania Tap & Pay first) agreed as interim mitigation.
